svg.title: Deploy pipeline
svg.desc: A deploy of one commit through Build, Test, Deploy and Live. The working stage glows blue and pulses while packets flow along the arrow into it; a finished stage turns green with a check. Here the tests are flagged to fail: Test turns red and shakes, the stages after it dim behind a stop sign and a banner says the pipeline halted. Then the flag clears, Test passes, the deploy rolls out and Live lights up and broadcasts. The page passes the XState value; the scene's states say where each clock rests.
